articles.title: Superfluid Qubit Design Predicts Fewer Errors—Testing Comes Next
articles.summary: A calculation is a starting point, not a completed machine. Researchers at the University of Surrey propose using electrically neutral superfluid helium-3 to protect a qubit from some common disturbances.

articles.title: Swiss Glacier Loss Shows Why Winter Snow Matters
articles.summary: A smaller glacier can lose a bigger percentage of its ice even while losing less ice overall. Switzerland’s latest measurements show a 5.5 percent decline, with consequences for rivers and hydropower.

articles.title: Protein’s Many Jobs Explain Why “More” Is a Complicated Claim
articles.summary: A nutrient can be essential without making every fortified snack healthier. A Smithsonian report examines protein’s roles, changing adult guidelines and why individual needs differ.
